visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens in a dimly lit studio with blue and purple accent lights where six young adults are gathered around an automatic mahjong table. Two women are seated playing, while a man in a white t-shirt, a man in a grey suit, and a woman in a black jacket stand behind them, all laughing and looking down at the green tiles. (2) The man in the grey suit with bleached hair leans in closer, while the woman in the black jacket stands with her mouth wide open in a mid-laugh expression. Lighting from above casts shadows on the group, highlighting the textures of their casual and semi-formal clothing. (3) A cut reveals a man in a white t-shirt and glasses holding a clipboard, laughing exaggeratedly with his head tilted back, while the seated players look up at him. Studio lighting equipment, including a large softbox, is partially visible in the frame. (4) The setting shifts slightly to show a large wall mural depicting 'The School of Athens' as a woman in a tan hoodie playfully handles a man in a white t-shirt, both grinning. (5) A man is shown looking into the viewfinder of a Sony digital camera, displaying a high-contrast image of a woman at the table on the flip-out screen. (6) The blonde man in the grey suit is seated alone at the mahjong table, resting his head on his hand in a frustrated or contemplative pose, surrounded by disorganized mahjong tiles. (7) Finally, the man in the white t-shirt sits in a studio chair, clutching a square white plush toy with a camera-lens face, laughing joyfully toward the ceiling as red and blue neon lights glow in the background.
